types.name: ConfigParams
docs: Config the game owner sets (`init_lobby` / `update_config`).

types.name: GameEntry
docs: PDA `[GAME_SEED, game_program]`. Never closed (I4) — only `Suspended`.
Layout: specs/designs/01 §4 (220 bytes).

types.name: GameStatus
docs: ⚠️ Never reorder — the relayer filters `GameEntry` with memcmp(offset 10, 0x00 = Active).
⚠️ INVARIANT: every explicit value MUST equal its variant index. The IDL carries no
discriminant values, so `declare_program!` consumers encode the *index*; a gap or
out-of-order value would silently desync them. Append only, next value = next index
(guarded by `enum_bytes_frozen_v1` + `enum_byte_equals_declaration_index` and the
compile-time `enum_tripwire` in tests/test_layout.rs).

types.name: LobbyConfig
docs: PDA `[b"lobby_config", game_program]` — one per game.

types.name: Matchmaker
docs: PDA `[b"matchmaker", game_program]` — one per game. Never closed in v1 (room_id uniqueness).

fields.name: next_room_id
docs: Starts at 1 · only `checked_add(1)` in the ix that creates Room `next_room_id`.

types.name: PlayerClaim
docs: PDA `[b"claim", player]` — one per player, hub-wide (D8). Created only by `init_claim`.

fields.name: rent_payer
docs: 🔒 R1: written once in `init_claim`, never overwritten.

fields.name: last_created_at
docs: n1: last room this player created (CREATE_COOLDOWN_SECS) · 0 = never. Took 8 B of `reserved`.

types.name: Room
docs: PDA `[b"room", game_program, room_id.to_le_bytes()]`.

fields.name: rent_payer
docs: L3/D11 — `close_room` refunds only here · written once at creation.

fields.name: seats
docs: len = max_seats for the room's whole life (never push/pop).

types.name: RoomTtl
docs: Seconds. Snapshotted into every Room at creation (01 §3).

fields.name: player
docs: `Pubkey::default()` when Empty / Bot.

fields.name: ready
docs: ReadyCheck only · reset when entering ReadyCheck.

fields.name: left
docs: `leave_seat` during Playing (seat stays · claim dies).
